Name: Mouth Protection
Author: Gabbemaster
Description:
Gabbemasters Mouth Protection for Json Assets - Version 1.0.0
Prevents diseases from spreading... To your mouth... Or something. I dunno.

:: Required Mods::
SMAPI (https://smapi.io/)
Json Assets (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)

:: What This Mod Adds::
A Mouth Protection piece, available for purchace from our saviour the Hat Mouse.

:: Installation Instructions::
1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Wash your hands
3. Download and install the latest version of Json Assets
4. Wash your hands
5. Copy the '[JA] Mouth Protection' folder to Mods
6. Wash your hands again
7. You're done! Run the game.
